## Current Research
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Behavioral Nudge Field Experiment for Breast Cancer Screening

::: {.collaborators}
**Collaborators:** D. Schwartz and S. Mondschein
:::

::: {.description}
This project studies whether behavioral nudges can increase participation in breast cancer screening programs. Using a field experiment, we evaluate how different communication strategies affect patient engagement and follow-through.
:::

::: {.card-actions}
[Work in Progress]{.badge-wip}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Humanized AI Avatars and Messenger Gender in Dental Post-Procedure Instructions

::: {.collaborators}
**Collaborators:** D. Schwartz and D. Benadof
:::

::: {.description}
This project examines how humanized AI avatars and messenger characteristics influence patients' adherence to post-procedure instructions. The study consists of two randomized experiments focused on communication effectiveness in healthcare contexts.
:::

::: {.card-actions}
[Accepted at JMIR]{.badge-accepted}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Identifying Factors Predicting Kidney Graft Survival in Chile Using Elastic-Net-Regularized Cox Regression

::: {.collaborators}
**With:** L. Magga, S. Maturana, M. Olivares, M. Valdevenito, J. Chapochnik, F. González, A. Kompatzki, H. Müller, J. Pefaur, C. Ulloa, and R. Valjalo
:::

::: {.description}
This paper develops predictive models for kidney graft survival using regularized survival analysis techniques applied to Chilean transplant data. Published in *Medicina* (2022).
:::
